style: schematic / diagrammatic. Pure black stage, two floating panels: a dark code-agent panel above, a simplified Bunny Blitz game diagram below. Flat vector game art (platform slabs, glyph bunny, gold coins) in the Bunny Blitz brand palette. Causal chain is the hero: type -> eval -> flight -> impact -> spawn -> count.
font: system monospace (SF Mono/Menlo) for code, geometric sans for labels

customize.borrowed_mechanic: confetti component's seeded index-function particle values (deterministic per-index targets) reapplied to the coin ring burst

content.affordance: the game panel is the receiving surface; the bunny's standing point is the impact target and the centre of the spawn ring

avoid: HUD chip top-right of game panel
BUNNY BLITZ chip top-left of game panel

connectors: packet flight arc (x power1.inOut + y power2.in) with a 4-dot comet trail

beats.what: agent panel enters (y -44 -> 0), game panel follows at 0.20 — staggered reveal
line 1 types, 34 char spans revealed by display; the caret rides the frontier in flow
CAUSE: the 'unity eval' pill ignites cyan; the code block glows
the code collapses and leaves the layout
a glowing C# packet condenses where the code was
flight 0.64s: the packet arcs down-LEFT into the game panel (x power1.inOut + y power2.in), shrinking 1 -> 0.62, 4-dot comet trail
IMPACT: packet pops, cyan shockwave ring + flash, bunny squashes, panel recoils 9px, border flashes cyan, agent reports '✓ evaluated'
STILLNESS 0.38s — the flash decays, nothing else moves (dramatic comma)
CLIMAX: 8 coins burst from the hero and settle on the ring (back.out(1.4), stagger 0.05); gold spawn glow rises
sequenced UI life: HUD counts 0 -> 8 on a steps(8) proxy, one tick per coin, each coin pinging as it is counted
the total lands: HUD '8' pops to 1.16x, gold sweep runs the panel, agent appends '· 8 coins spawned'

content.result_line: agent panel shows '✓ evaluated' on the impact frame, then '· 8 coins spawned' when the count lands — so the report never precedes the effect

motion_notes: single continuous scene — no cuts, so the Seam Law/ledger does not apply; motion-doctrine's causal-motion + stillness-before-climax + no-idle-wobble rules do
banned eases avoided: no bounce.out, no elastic.out
every phase owned by a sustained-motion route: staged reveals -> animated sequence -> sequenced UI life
no seeded randomness needed; all per-index values are pure functions of the coin index

verify.check: passed — layout 0/0, motion 0/0, contrast 78/78 WCAG AA
known_info_findings: caret adjacency flagged as occlusion at t=1.17/1.94 (the caret sits in the next, display:none cell)
#game-inner 3.45px overflow at t=3.5 — the intentional impact recoil, clipped by #game
verify.immediateRender: disabled timeline-wide: CSS is the authored t=0 state, so no later fromTo can stamp its from-vars into frame 0
